summary: Senior test automation engineer with 8+ years in test automation and quality leadership across banking, FinTech, financial markets, telecom, mobile and AI/GenAI, specialising in AI chatbot and NLP testing. Certified in ISTQB® CTAL-TAE v2.0 (Advanced, Test Automation Engineering), ISTQB® CTFL v4.0 and Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate (Jan 2026).

I built a Python + BERT semantic embedding framework from scratch to validate LLM/Rasa chatbot responses, and work daily with Python frameworks, Selenium, Postman and Robot Framework for functional, regression, performance and API testing.

I lead a team of 5 testers, have interviewed 25 candidates for automation tester roles, and own test plans, RTMs, defect traceability and deployment sign-offs. I currently lead automation for Rakuten Mobile (Japan)'s shop reservation platform, where parallel execution cut Jenkins builds from ~2 hours to ~45 minutes and Claude AI lifted output from ~40 to nearly 200 test cases in two months; before that, bilingual Kotlin mobile automation for Rakuten Link (40+ test cases a week).

I have delivered 4,500+ automated test cases and found 480+ critical defects for 7+ global clients, cutting regression cycles from days to hours. I am experienced in Conversational AI test strategy, sprint planning, CI/CD (Jenkins, AWS Device Farm), cross-functional stakeholder leadership and quality metrics reporting to technical and non-technical audiences.

Tester of the Quarter (Q4 2025) with 15+ client and management recognitions. Completing ISTQB CTAL-TM v3.0, CT-AI v2.0 and CT-ATLaS (expected Nov 2026). Open to AWS, GCP and containerised environments; open to Senior Test Automation and QA Lead / Test Lead roles.
